new_failures.failed_witness: The first memory-registry probe used the wrong parent path and found no MEMORY.md.
new_failures.recovery: Resolved the documented memories subdirectory and read only the task-relevant registry windows.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve memory paths from the installed memory-root contract before lookup.

new_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell foreach producer was piped directly and raised EmptyPipeElement before any mutation.
new_failures.recovery: Materialized the foreach rows before converting them to compact JSON.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Never pipe directly from a PowerShell foreach statement.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first raw authorization-state projection exceeded its bounded output before EOF.
new_failures.recovery: Reread the exact current authorization state in bounded numbered windows through EOF.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Measure dense mutable-state documents and use conservative windows before projection.

new_failures.failed_witness: One numbered line-window projection returned an empty selection after a wrong range assumption.
new_failures.recovery: Used Select-Object with an explicit skip and first count against the measured document.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Measure line counts before requesting a numbered window.

new_failures.failed_witness: A broad recursive builder-pattern search exceeded the model-visible result window.
new_failures.recovery: Reduced the search to exact owner-template inventories and bounded file windows.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Inventory filenames first and search only the selected lifecycle template.

new_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell JSON projection indexed an output array while that array was still being constructed.
new_failures.recovery: Used per-record local variables and emitted the completed collection only after construction.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not self-reference a PowerShell assignment expression under construction.

new_failures.failed_witness: The sparse worktree creation exceeded the command-visible window while Git checkout continued in the background.
new_failures.recovery: Waited for the exact checkout processes, then audited the branch, head, lock, sparse patterns, status, and file count without replaying creation.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: After a checkout timeout, inspect exact processes and persisted Git state before any retry.

new_failures.failed_witness: One combined multi-page PyPI projection exceeded the model-visible result window.
new_failures.recovery: Opened the three exact official PyPI project pages in a bounded current-version projection.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use one bounded official package page per uncertain version when projections are dense.

new_failures.failed_witness: The prior prose baton reported a 10,190-row proposal chain while all three structured exact-final ledgers reported 11,090.
new_failures.recovery: Bound the remaster to the mutually consistent frozen x1, phase-truth, and source-ledger values and retained the prose discrepancy as historical evidence.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Prefer mutually consistent structured exact-final ledgers over stale prose and disclose every disagreement.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first stale-label search used look-ahead syntax unsupported by the default ripgrep engine.
new_failures.recovery: Repeated the bounded literal search without look-around and manually separated current remaster labels from inherited anchors.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use --pcre2 only when look-around is essential; otherwise prefer explicit literal searches.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined exact-file cleanup command for copied untracked lifecycle templates was rejected by host policy before execution.
new_failures.recovery: Deleted only the six known untracked template files through the patch surface and preserved the planning-only x1 boundary.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use the patch surface for exact untracked template removal when host command policy rejects an otherwise bounded cleanup.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first complete reachable proposal audit found one exact collision and four titles at or above the 0.78 token-Jaccard quarantine threshold.
new_failures.recovery: Projected the exact four neighbour pairs and refined only those proposal titles while preserving hypotheses, dispositions, gates, and the audit threshold.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Run the complete reachable semantic-neighbour audit before freeze and preserve every quarantined first attempt.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined test JSON-parse and stale-label shell returned no attributable output under nested quoting.
new_failures.recovery: Split the three read-only validators; 20 tests passed, 20 JSON documents parsed, and the literal stale-label search returned no match.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep validation commands independently attributable when regex quoting crosses JavaScript and PowerShell boundaries.
